name: @12-apps/auth
description: Plug-and-play authentication plugin: Auth.js wiring and the e-mail + password flow (.), host-mounted backend surface (./server: routes, messages, mail templates, the duck-typed credential and settings store seams), auth UI (./react: screens, whole login/sign-up pages, the platform settings screen), a Hono mount (./hono), delivery through @12-apps/notifications (./notifications) and packaged Gherkin journeys (./e2e) — plus the package-owned Prisma fragment synced into the host schema. Who the users are is the host's and arrives as config. Adoption contract in ADOPTING.md.

env.name: AUTH_SECRET
env.description: Signs sessions and tokens; the runtime refuses to start without it.

env.name: AUTH_URL
env.description: Public origin of the sign-in surface; defaults to the mount path.

env.name: AUTH_TRUST_HOST
env.description: "true" to trust the reverse proxy's Host header.

env.name: AUTH_DEBUG
env.description: Verbose Auth.js logging; keep off in production.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth app; the provider is offered only when both halves are set.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Second half of the Google OAuth app.

env.name: FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Facebook OAuth app; offered only when both halves are set.

env.name: FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Second half of the Facebook OAuth app.

env.name: APPLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Apple OAuth app; offered only when both halves are set.

env.name: APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Second half of the Apple OAuth app.

env.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
env.description: Comma-separated superadmin allowlist; empty denies everyone.

env.name: OAUTH_MOCK_ISSUER
env.description: Points the Google provider at the e2e mock OpenID issuer; tests only.

env.name: SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION
env.description: Skips the env schema — build steps that never serve a request.
